title: A new page, close to home
body: Last night, I attended the 2nd Annual International Book Fair in Minneapolis. The event drew a strong turnout, but I would have appreciated more time for authors to discuss their books and engage with readers. I was particularly interested in hearing more from Harun Maruf about Inside Al-Shabaab. Having read the book, I had questions I hoped to ask, but there was no opportunity to do so. Future events would benefit from more time for audience discussion.
